WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1791234489947
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793912889947
    AND e.event IN ('$web_vitals')
),
first_seen AS (
  SELECT pid, MIN(ts_ms) AS t0
  FROM ev
  WHERE event = '$web_vitals' AND ts_ms < 1793826489947 AND 1 = 1
  GROUP BY pid
),
c AS (SELECT pid, (((t0 / 86400000) - (((t0 / 86400000) + 3) % 7)) * 86400000) AS cbucket FROM first_seen),
a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pid, (((ts_ms / 86400000) - (((ts_ms / 86400000) + 3) % 7)) * 86400000) AS abucket
  FROM ev
  WHERE event = '$web_vitals' AND 1 = 1
)
SELECT c.cbucket AS cohort, (a.abucket - c.cbucket) / 604800000 AS k, COUNT(DISTINCT c.pid) AS n
FROM c JOIN a ON a.pid = c.pid
WHERE a.abucket > c.cbucket AND (a.abucket - c.cbucket) / 604800000 <= 8
GROUP BY c.cbucket, (a.abucket - c.cbucket) / 604800000
UNION ALL
SELECT cbucket AS cohort, 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n FROM c GROUP BY cbucket
